title: Weather
content:
Type: WTHR
Papyrus: Weather Script Weather objects are found in the Object Window under WorldData. To create a new Weather, right-click in the list of Weathers in the Object Window and select "new" from the popup. To create a new Weather based off an existing one, right-click the Weather you wish to use as a basis and select "duplicate". To delete an existing Weather, right-click that Weather and select delete. Editor Dialog: thumb|right|900px - - Show Color In Render Window: See Also: - WorldData Category
